title: Started working on 2.5D pixelated postapo RPG with late 90s retro style. My original vision took huge detour to this:
author: LegendaryJohnny
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/kxyerg4fjf0i1.png

It is still kind of 2.5D - I will allow players to use only one perspective, but I have added zoom in zoom out and possibility to camera look 90 degrees right, 90 degrees left. I have bones of the game almost set up and I will start working soon on the flesh.

How about your projects? Is your original vision also changing significantly, making your development more difficult? If I was staying with my original vision, it would be easier, but I feel there is enough of these pixelated games and I am up to challenge to make it visually nice.
